title: SMCH Operations Master Synthetic Workbook
content:
MASTER WORKBOOK: Saveetha Medical College and Hospital (SMCH) Operations Master Synthetic Workbook (Operations_Synthetic_Workbook.xlsx).
CONSOLIDATED SHEETS:
1. Operations Requests: 20 comprehensive operational request scenarios spanning Admissions, Discharges, LIS, RIS, Billing, Insurance Preauth, Equipment Breakdowns, Bed Transfers, and Incident Reporting.
2. Approved Knowledge Articles: 30 approved knowledge base articles (KA-001 to KA-030) covering step-by-step system interactions across HIS, LIS, RIS, Billing, EMR, TPA, CSSD, and PACS.
3. Workflow Information: Complete state machine specifications for 8 core workflows (WF-001 Admission, WF-002 Discharge Clearance, WF-003 Insurance Preauth, WF-004 Bed Transfer, WF-005 STAT Lab Panic Value, WF-006 Incident Reporting, WF-007 Medico-Legal Case, WF-008 Narcotic Drug Control).
4. Routing Rules: 15 routing rules (R-001 to R-015) defining operational triggers, target teams, SLA hours, priority levels, and escalation criteria.
5. Field Definitions: 25 structured healthcare operational data field definitions including validation regex patterns, display labels, missing prompts, and document usage.
